guide.title: How to write a Nano Banana 2.1 prompt
guide.intro: Four structures that recur in the prompts on this page.

items.h: Keep the product, change the rest
items.formula: Keep [product] exactly + new surface or scene + light + shadow
items.t: The e-commerce prompts open by locking the shape, label, colors and proportions, then describe only the background, the light and a contact shadow.

items.formula: Object + "exact words in quotes" + script or language + where it sits
items.t: Menus, signs and newspapers put every line in quotes and name the script, so prices, Arabic joins and Hindi words come out as written.

items.h: Lock the face from a photo
items.formula: Use the reference only for the face + new hair, outfit, scene and camera
items.t: Portrait prompts say which features to keep from the upload and redesign everything else, which keeps one person consistent across a series.

items.formula: exactly N + object + position in the frame
items.t: Stress-test prompts list counts and positions as JSON fields, and give clocks and watches an exact time such as 10:42.
Two-image prompts refer to IMG_1 and IMG_2, or image1 and image2, so the model knows which picture is the scene and which is the product or style.

items.h: JSON works as well as prose.
items.t: Several portraits and tests are written as JSON with fields for camera, subject and lighting, which makes one part easy to change without touching the rest.
The violin and launch-poster prompts ask the model to look things up first, so the plaque text and poster details come from current information.
Template prompts mark what to replace in brackets, such as [NAME] or [medium close-up], and keep the lighting and framing fixed.
Cards marked as needing a reference only work after you upload your own photo; the before image on the card shows what kind of photo fits.

items.question: Are these Nano Banana 2.1 prompts free to use?
items.answer: You can copy, edit and run any prompt. The prompts and results belong to the creators credited on each card, so check the original post before reusing a result commercially. The lygerone cards are under CC BY 4.0 with credit.

items.question: What does Use do on a card?
items.answer: It opens the Nano Banana 2.1 model page with the prompt filled in and the aspect ratio set when the model supports it. Reference images are not attached, so upload your own for the cards marked as needing one.

items.question: Which aspect ratios does Nano Banana 2.1 support?
items.answer: auto plus 14 ratios: 1:1, 2:3, 3:2, 3:4, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, 16:9, 21:9, and the long banner shapes 1:4, 4:1, 1:8 and 8:1. Without size, generations are 1:1 and edits keep the reference image's ratio.

items.question: What resolutions can I choose?
items.answer: resolution takes 1k, 2k or 4k, with 1k as the default. Each tier has its own price per image, listed on the model page.

items.question: How many reference images can Nano Banana 2.1 take?
items.answer: Up to 14 HTTPS image URLs in images, for POST /v1/images/edits. A local file has to be uploaded first with POST /v1/uploads/images.

items.question: Can Nano Banana 2.1 search the web?
items.answer: Yes. web_search grounds the image in Google search results and image_search in Google image results; neither costs extra on APIKO.

items.question: Can I use the edit prompts without a mask?
items.answer: Yes. Every edit card here works from the uploaded image and the text alone. Prompts that need a hand-painted mask were left out because the playground has no mask brush.

items.question: Which language should I write the prompts in?
items.answer: The prompts are shown in the author's original language, including English, Japanese and Chinese, and are not translated. Copy them as they are or rewrite them in the language you prefer.

items.question: Why does my result look different from the card?
items.answer: Image models give a different result on each run. Authors may also have used a reference image, a higher resolution, a thinking level or another app such as Google Flow or Gemini.

items.question: Should I use Nano Banana 2.1, Nano Banana 2 or Pro?
items.answer: Start with 2.1 for most new projects, especially text on posters, long banners and prompts that need current facts. The model pages compare ratios, reference limits, speed and price side by side.

guide.title: Nano Banana 2.1 提示词怎么写
guide.intro: 本页提示词里反复出现的四种结构。

items.h: 商品不动，只换其余部分
items.formula: [商品] 保持原样 + 新台面或场景 + 光线 + 阴影
items.t: 电商提示词先锁定形状、标签、颜色和比例，再只描述背景、光线和接触阴影。

items.formula: 物体 + "引号里的原文" + 文字或语言 + 位置
items.t: 菜单、招牌和报纸把每一行都放进引号并写明文字种类，价格、阿拉伯文连写和印地语才会照写出来。

items.formula: 参考图只用于脸 + 新的发型、服装、场景和机位
items.t: 人像提示词写明从上传图里保留哪些五官，其余全部重新设计，一组照片里就能保持同一个人。

items.formula: 恰好 N 个 + 物体 + 画面中的位置
items.t: 压力测试提示词用 JSON 字段列出数量和位置，时钟和手表写到具体时间，比如 10:42。
双图提示词写 IMG_1、IMG_2 或 image1、image2，模型才知道哪张是场景、哪张是商品或风格。

items.h: JSON 和自然语言一样好用。
items.t: 有几条人像和测试用 JSON 写成镜头、人物、光线等字段，改其中一项不会动到其他部分。

items.h: 联网搜索能补上真实信息。
items.t: 小提琴和发布海报两条提示词让模型先查资料，铭牌文字和海报内容都来自最新信息。
模板提示词用方括号标出要替换的部分，比如 [NAME]、[medium close-up]，光线和构图保持不变。
标注需要参考图的卡片要先上传自己的照片才能用，卡片上的原图示意了哪类照片合适。

items.question: 这些 Nano Banana 2.1 提示词可以免费用吗？
items.answer: 任何提示词都可以复制、修改和运行。提示词和效果归卡片标注的创作者所有，商用效果图前请先看原帖。lygerone 的卡片按 CC BY 4.0 许可，注明出处即可使用。

items.question: 卡片上的「使用」做什么？
items.answer: 打开 Nano Banana 2.1 模型页并填好提示词，模型支持时一并设好画幅比例。参考图不会带过去，标注需要参考图的卡片请上传自己的图片。

items.question: Nano Banana 2.1 支持哪些画幅比例？
分辨率可以选哪些？
items.answer: resolution 可选 1k、2k、4k，默认 1k。每档按张计价，价格见模型页。

items.question: Nano Banana 2.1 最多能传几张参考图？
items.answer: images 最多 14 个 HTTPS 图片地址，用于 POST /v1/images/edits。本地文件先用 POST /v1/uploads/images 上传。

items.question: Nano Banana 2.1 能联网搜索吗？
items.answer: 能。web_search 用谷歌搜索结果、image_search 用谷歌图片结果给画面找依据，在 APIKO 都不额外收费。

items.question: 编辑类提示词需要蒙版吗？
items.answer: 不需要。这里的编辑卡片只靠上传的图片和文字就能用。需要手绘蒙版的提示词没有收录，因为试用台没有蒙版画笔。

items.question: 提示词用什么语言写？
items.answer: 提示词按作者原文展示，有英文、日文和中文，没有翻译。可以原样复制，也可以改写成你习惯的语言。

items.question: 为什么我跑出来的和卡片不一样？
items.answer: 图像模型每次生成的结果都不同。作者也可能用了参考图、更高分辨率、思考等级，或在 Google Flow、Gemini 等其他应用里生成。

items.question: 该选 Nano Banana 2.1、Nano Banana 2 还是 Pro？
items.answer: 大多数新项目先用 2.1，尤其是海报文字、长条横幅和需要最新信息的提示词。模型页把三者的画幅、参考图上限、速度和价格放在一起对比。

items.formula: 參考圖只用於臉 + 新的髮型、服裝、場景和機位
items.t: 人像提示詞寫明從上傳圖裡保留哪些五官，其餘全部重新設計，一組照片裡就能維持同一個人。

items.formula: 恰好 N 個 + 物體 + 畫面中的位置
items.t: 壓力測試提示詞用 JSON 欄位列出數量和位置，時鐘和手錶寫到具體時間，例如 10:42。
雙圖提示詞寫 IMG_1、IMG_2 或 image1、image2，模型才知道哪張是場景、哪張是商品或風格。

items.h: JSON 和自然語言一樣好用。
items.t: 有幾則人像和測試用 JSON 寫成鏡頭、人物、光線等欄位，改其中一項不會動到其他部分。

items.h: 聯網搜尋能補上真實資訊。
items.t: 小提琴和發表海報兩則提示詞讓模型先查資料，銘牌文字和海報內容都來自最新資訊。
範本提示詞用方括號標出要替換的部分，例如 [NAME]、[medium close-up]，光線和構圖保持不變。
標註需要參考圖的卡片要先上傳自己的照片才能用，卡片上的原圖示意了哪類照片合適。

items.question: 這些 Nano Banana 2.1 提示詞可以免費用嗎？

items.question: 卡片上的「使用」做什麼？
items.answer: 開啟 Nano Banana 2.1 模型頁並填好提示詞，模型支援時一併設好畫面比例。參考圖不會帶過去，標註需要參考圖的卡片請上傳自己的圖片。

items.question: Nano Banana 2.1 支援哪些畫面比例？

items.question: Nano Banana 2.1 最多能傳幾張參考圖？
items.answer: images 最多 14 個 HTTPS 圖片網址，用於 POST /v1/images/edits。本機檔案先用 POST /v1/uploads/images 上傳。

items.question: Nano Banana 2.1 能聯網搜尋嗎？

items.question: 編輯類提示詞需要遮罩嗎？

items.question: 提示詞用什麼語言寫？

items.question: 為什麼我跑出來的和卡片不一樣？

items.question: 該選 Nano Banana 2.1、Nano Banana 2 還是 Pro？

items.t: 이커머스 프롬프트는 먼저 형태·라벨·색·비율을 고정하고, 배경과 조명, 접지 그림자만 설명합니다.

두 장 프롬프트는 IMG_1, IMG_2 또는 image1, image2로 불러서 어느 쪽이 장면이고 어느 쪽이 제품이나 스타일인지 알려 줍니다.
일부 인물·테스트 프롬프트는 카메라, 인물, 조명을 JSON 필드로 써서 한 부분만 쉽게 바꿀 수 있습니다.
바이올린과 출시 포스터 프롬프트는 먼저 찾아보게 해서 명판 문구와 포스터 내용이 최신 정보에서 나옵니다.
템플릿 프롬프트는 [NAME], [medium close-up]처럼 바꿀 부분을 대괄호로 표시하고 조명과 구도는 고정합니다.
참고 이미지가 필요한 카드는 내 사진을 올려야 작동합니다. 카드의 원본 이미지가 어떤 사진이 맞는지 보여 줍니다.

items.question: 이 Nano Banana 2.1 프롬프트는 무료로 써도 되나요?
items.answer: 모든 프롬프트를 복사·수정·실행할 수 있습니다. 프롬프트와 결과물의 권리는 카드에 표시된 제작자에게 있으니, 결과물을 상업적으로 쓰기 전에 원문을 확인하세요. lygerone 카드는 출처 표기 시 CC BY 4.0으로 쓸 수 있습니다.

items.question: 카드의 「사용」은 무엇을 하나요?
items.answer: Nano Banana 2.1 모델 페이지를 열어 프롬프트를 채우고, 지원되는 경우 화면 비율도 맞춥니다. 참고 이미지는 함께 넘어가지 않으니 필요한 카드는 직접 업로드하세요.

items.question: Nano Banana 2.1은 어떤 화면 비율을 지원하나요?
해상도는 무엇을 고를 수 있나요?
items.answer: resolution은 1k, 2k, 4k 중 하나이며 기본값은 1k입니다. 등급마다 장당 가격이 다르며 모델 페이지에 나와 있습니다.

items.question: 참고 이미지는 몇 장까지 넣을 수 있나요?
items.answer: POST /v1/images/edits의 images에 HTTPS 이미지 URL을 최대 14개까지 넣을 수 있습니다. 로컬 파일은 먼저 POST /v1/uploads/images로 올리세요.

items.question: Nano Banana 2.1은 웹 검색을 할 수 있나요?
items.answer: 네. web_search는 Google 검색 결과, image_search는 Google 이미지 결과를 근거로 이미지를 만들며, APIKO에서는 둘 다 추가 요금이 없습니다.

items.question: 편집 프롬프트에 마스크가 필요한가요?
items.answer: 아니요. 여기 편집 카드는 업로드한 이미지와 텍스트만으로 작동합니다. 손으로 칠한 마스크가 필요한 프롬프트는 플레이그라운드에 마스크 브러시가 없어 제외했습니다.

items.question: 프롬프트는 어떤 언어로 써야 하나요?
items.answer: 프롬프트는 영어, 일본어, 중국어 등 작성자의 원문 그대로이며 번역하지 않았습니다. 그대로 복사하거나 편한 언어로 다시 써도 됩니다.

items.question: 결과가 카드와 다르게 나오는 이유는?
items.answer: 이미지 모델은 실행할 때마다 다른 결과를 냅니다. 작성자가 참고 이미지, 더 높은 해상도, thinking level을 쓰거나 Google Flow, Gemini 같은 다른 앱에서 만들었을 수도 있습니다.

items.question: Nano Banana 2.1, Nano Banana 2, Pro 중 무엇을 써야 하나요?
items.answer: 대부분의 새 프로젝트는 2.1로 시작하세요. 특히 포스터 글자, 긴 배너, 최신 정보가 필요한 프롬프트에 맞습니다. 모델 페이지에서 비율, 참고 이미지 한도, 속도, 가격을 나란히 비교할 수 있습니다.

cards.prompt:
A spontaneous evening shot, a candid moment caught in motion. Taken on an iPhone 17 Pro with flash. The frame should look like a real photo from a personal gallery, not a staged fashion shoot.

POSE: The girl is sitting directly on wide, light-colored stone steps, with her torso slightly turned into a 3/4 angle. One leg is bent closer to her body, while the other rests on the step below.

At the moment of capture, the girl raises both hands to quickly tie her hair into a high, messy ponytail. Her elbows are positioned on opposite sides of her head, with her hands still in motion. Her head is slightly turned to the side, and her gaze is directed past the camera. Her lips are relaxed and slightly parted.

The frame is captured in the exact in-between second — her hair is not fully tied yet, part of it is still held in her hands, and several strands are flying freely near her face. Subtle directional motion blur on the hands, hair ends, and edges of the clothing. Do not blur or deform the facial features; the face must remain clear, recognizable, and true to the original.

HAIR: Very long, thick hair. Most of the hair is being lifted upward and backward by her hands, while the lower section still falls freely over her shoulders and back. A few thin strands have come loose around the temples and cheeks. Do not let them cover the eyes, nose, or lips.

MAKEUP: Expressive modern evening makeup. A thin, elongated black winged eyeliner, voluminous lashes with a fox-eye effect, laminated brows. The lips are outlined with a cool brownish-pink pencil slightly darker than the natural lip tone, with a translucent berry-nude gloss inside. Skin is slightly tanned, fresh, with visible real pores and natural micro-texture.

CLOTHING: A fitted white top with a wide boat neckline, revealing the collarbones and one shoulder. Long sleeves partially cover the hands. Bottoms: loose black low-rise trousers with soft folds.

ACCESSORIES: Large silver hoop earrings, one chunky silver ring. Manicure: short square nails, in a shade matching the top.

ENVIRONMENT: A wide outdoor stone staircase at night. Light-colored natural stone occupies almost the entire background and creates graphic horizontal lines. No restaurants, cars, signs, flowers, or decorative objects. The upper part of the frame gradually falls into darkness.

FLASH PHOTOGRAPHY: Deep night. The only main light source is the direct built-in iPhone flash. It sharply illuminates the face, collarbones, raised hands, top, and nearest steps.

The light falls off quickly into the depth of the staircase. Distant steps fade into gray-black shadow. No soft studio lighting and no evenly illuminated scene.

CAMERA: iPhone 17 Pro, vertical 9:16 format. Medium-close framing, approximately from mid-thighs to the space slightly above the raised hands. The camera is close, positioned slightly above and to the side, as if someone standing nearby suddenly raised their phone and pressed the shutter while the girl was tying her hair.

The girl is not perfectly centered. One elbow is close to the upper edge of the frame, and part of the jacket is naturally cropped at the bottom. Handheld, slightly imperfect framing.

Natural skin, realistic texture of hair, knit fabric, trousers, and stone. Slight digital noise, visible fine film grain, muted nighttime color rendering, deep shadows, subtle vignette, RAW unedited feeling.

Do not use 8K, ultra sharp, HDR, beauty filters, airbrushing, plastic skin, artificial bokeh, studio lighting, perfect symmetry, or a glossy AI look.

The circle sits slightly above center, with the thick, weathered concrete ring edge visible on the left side.

Extremely high contrast, deep crushed blacks, bright highlights, strong geometric lines and curves.

cards.prompt:
Create one "Secret Shadow" image per upload. Never combine photos.

Format: Vertical 16:9, presented as a single instant-film photo with a slightly thicker ivory bottom border.

Photo: Keep the uploaded photo faithful. Preserve the subject, pose, faces, colors and setting. Do not redesign, restyle or replace anything. Only adjust light and shading as much as the shadow requires.

Light: Add one low, warm, late-afternoon light source from the side, consistent with the scene, so the main subject casts a long, crisp shadow across the nearest wall, floor or ground.

Shadow Logic: Ask what this subject secretly wishes it were doing right now, based on what the photo shows. The shadow does exactly that. For example, a person at a laptop might cast the shadow of someone asleep in a hammock, a dog waiting by the door might cast the shadow of a dog driving a car, and a coffee cup might cast the shadow of a smoking volcano. Choose one clear, specific, surprising wish for each upload. Never fall back on the same idea.

Shadow Rules: The shadow must begin exactly where the subject touches the surface and match its outline at the base, then transform as it stretches away. It must behave like a real shadow: dark, soft-edged, flat on the surface it falls on, bending over steps and corners, with no color or inner detail. Only the main subject gets a secret shadow; everything else casts normal shadows.

Caption: Handwrite one short, dry, witty English caption in black ink on the bottom border, based on the shadow's wish. Under six words, understated, never inspirational.

Style: Real photography, warm golden light, subtle film grain, quiet and cinematic. It should feel like the shadow was always there and nobody noticed.

Negative: No extra subjects or props, no colored or detailed shadows, no glow or magic effects, no change to faces or identity, no text except the caption, no watermark, no logo, no UI.

2x2 grid, 16:9 Anchor: AI picks topics (e.g., human eye / sunflower / vinyl record / cat's face) 

SUBJECT            ::= infer_most_iconic_visual_form(TOPIC)
SILHOUETTE         ::= extract_primary_shape(SUBJECT)
FEATURES           ::= infer_recognition_critical_features(SUBJECT)
FIELD_TYPE         ::= choose(radial | concentric | wave | vortex | contour | hybrid)
LINE_DENSITY       ::= high
COLOR              ::= black_on_white
STYLE              ::= op_art + moiré + engraved contour illusion

BASE_FIELD ::=
generate_parallel_or_concentric_lines(
    spacing = uniform,
    thickness = constant_or_slightly_variable
)

DEFORMATION_FIELD(x,y) ::=
Σ influence(
    FEATURES,
    silhouette_boundary,
    depth_estimate,
    focal_points
)

FINAL_LINES :=
warp(
    BASE_FIELD,
    vector_field = DEFORMATION_FIELD
)

RULES ::=
- SUBJECT must emerge only through deformation of continuous black lines
- avoid conventional outlines wherever possible
- contours bend, compress, expand, spiral, or redirect to reveal form
- preserve uninterrupted optical rhythm across figure and background
- high-information regions receive denser curvature changes
- low-information regions remain smoother
- negative space may define eyes, highlights, holes, or focal voids
- all lines remain crisp monochrome vector-like marks
